---- MODULE W4Od3m0p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Banks, MaxVer, MaxCap
VARIABLES lock, ver, seen, settler, posted, cap
Free == "free"
vars == <<lock, ver, seen, settler, posted, cap>>
Init ==
    /\ lock = Free
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ seen = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
    /\ settler = Free
    /\ posted = 0
    /\ cap = 1
Reread(b) == seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![b] = ver] /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, ver, settler, posted, cap>>
Acquire(b) ==
    /\ lock = Free
    /\ seen[b] = ver
    /\ posted < cap
    /\ lock' = b
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, seen, settler, posted, cap>>
StartSettle(b) ==
    /\ lock = b
    /\ settler = Free
    /\ posted < cap
    /\ settler' = b
    /\ posted' = posted + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, ver, seen, cap>>
EndSettle(b) ==
    /\ settler = b
    /\ settler' = Free
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, ver, seen, posted, cap>>
Release(b) ==
    /\ lock = b
    /\ settler = Free
    /\ ver < MaxVer
    /\ lock' = Free
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seen, settler, posted, cap>>
Resize(c) ==
    /\ c \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ cap' = c
    /\ posted' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, ver, seen, settler>>
Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Reread(b) \/ Acquire(b) \/ StartSettle(b) \/ EndSettle(b) \/ Release(b)
    \/ \E c \in 1..MaxCap : Resize(c)
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
SettlerHoldsLock == (settler /= Free) => (lock = settler)

CONSTANTS
  Banks = {b1, b2, b3}
  MaxVer = 2
  MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SettlerHoldsLock
nl:
Several regional banks share one interbank settlement engine that can post at most one settlement at a time. Each bank caches the engine's version number, then optimistically tries to acquire the engine only if its cached version still matches the live version. When a bank releases the engine it bumps the version, forcing every other bank to re-read before it can acquire again. A bank that holds the engine may begin settling a payment, and only one bank may be mid-settlement at any instant. The current batch capacity limits how many settlements a batch may post, and an operator can resize that capacity up or down while the system runs. A bank that observes a stale cached version must re-read it and retry its acquisition. The engine therefore behaves as a mutually exclusive critical resource guarded by an optimistic version check.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a bank is actively settling a payment, that same bank must currently hold the settlement engine lock, so no two banks can ever settle at once.

---- MODULE W4Od14m8p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Drones, Regions, MaxCap
VARIABLES phase, region, deployed, cap
None == "none"
vars == <<phase, region, deployed, cap>>
Init ==
    /\ phase = [d \in Drones |-> "idle"]
    /\ region = [d \in Drones |-> None]
    /\ deployed = [r \in Regions |-> 0]
    /\ cap = [r \in Regions |-> 1]
AcquireCoarse(d, rg) ==
    /\ phase[d] = "idle"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![d] = "coarse"]
    /\ region' = [region EXCEPT ![d] = rg]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<deployed, cap>>
AcquireFine(d) ==
    /\ phase[d] = "coarse"
    /\ deployed[region[d]] < cap[region[d]]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![d] = "fine"]
    /\ deployed' = [deployed EXCEPT ![region[d]] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, cap>>
ReleaseFine(d) ==
    /\ phase[d] = "fine"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![d] = "coarse"]
    /\ deployed' = [deployed EXCEPT ![region[d]] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<region, cap>>
ReleaseCoarse(d) ==
    /\ phase[d] = "coarse"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![d] = "idle"]
    /\ region' = [region EXCEPT ![d] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<deployed, cap>>
Resize(rg, c) ==
    /\ c \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ c >= deployed[rg]
    /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![rg] = c]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, region, deployed>>
Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones, rg \in Regions : AcquireCoarse(d, rg)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : AcquireFine(d) \/ ReleaseFine(d) \/ ReleaseCoarse(d)
    \/ \E rg \in Regions, c \in 1..MaxCap : Resize(rg, c)
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
CapacityRespected == \A r \in Regions : deployed[r] <= cap[r]

CONSTANTS
  Drones = {d1, d2}
  Regions = {r1, r2}
  MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A wildfire surveillance swarm assigns drones to burn regions, and within each region to a fine sector. A drone must first acquire the coarse region lock, then acquire a fine deployment slot inside that region; it can never grab a fine slot without holding the coarse lock first. Each region has a bounded number of deployment slots, and the count of drones actively deployed in a region must never exceed that region's capacity. Ground control may resize a region's capacity up or down while the mission runs, but it may never shrink a region below the number of drones already deployed there. A drone releases its fine slot before releasing the coarse region lock. This coarse-then-fine discipline keeps deployment counts bounded even as capacities shift.
SAFETY PROPERTY: For every region, the number of drones actively deployed in it never exceeds that region's current capacity.

    /\ timer' = [timer EXCEPT ![p] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, transit, frozen>>
Expire(p) ==
    /\ timer[p] = 1
    /\ timer' = [timer EXCEPT ![p] = 0]
    /\ transit' = transit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, frozen>>
Return(p) ==
    /\ ~frozen
    /\ timer[p] > 0
    /\ timer' = [timer EXCEPT ![p] = 0]
    /\ transit' = transit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, frozen>>
AdminRecall(p) ==
    /\ timer[p] > 0
    /\ timer' = [timer EXCEPT ![p] = 0]
    /\ transit' = transit + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, frozen>>
Shelve ==
    /\ transit > 0
    /\ transit' = transit - 1
    /\ shelf' = shelf + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<timer, frozen>>
AdminToggle ==
    /\ frozen' = ~frozen
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shelf, transit, timer>>

CONSTANTS
  Patrons = {p1, p2}
  Total = 2
  MaxLease = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CopiesConserved
nl:
A library lends a fixed number of copies of a title. A patron checks out a copy, which grants a lease with a fixed expiry countdown. While a lease is active its timer ticks down; when it reaches its final tick the lease expires and the copy is sent to a re-shelving transit area. A patron may also return a copy early, again routing it through transit, and a staff member later shelves transit copies back onto the open shelf. A librarian may freeze the title, which blocks new checkouts and voluntary returns, but an admin override can force-recall any leased copy even while the title is frozen. No copy is ever created or destroyed: every copy is always exactly one of on-shelf, in-transit, or out on an active lease.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of copies on the shelf, plus those in transit, plus those on active leases always equals the fixed total number of copies.

---- MODULE W4Od17m0p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Routers, Carousels, MaxCap, MaxVer
VARIABLES load, busy, ver, target, seen
None == "none"
vars == <<load, busy, ver, target, seen>>
Init ==
    /\ load = [c \in Carousels |-> 0]
    /\ busy = [c \in Carousels |-> FALSE]
    /\ ver = [c \in Carousels |-> 0]
    /\ target = [r \in Routers |-> None]
    /\ seen = [r \in Routers |-> 0]
Observe(r, c) ==
    /\ target[r] = None
    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![r] = c]
    /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![r] = ver[c]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, busy, ver>>
Place(r) ==
    /\ target[r] # None
    /\ LET c == target[r] IN
        /\ ~busy[c]
        /\ seen[r] = ver[c]
        /\ load[c] < MaxCap
        /\ ver[c] < MaxVer
        /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
        /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![r] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<busy, seen>>
Retry(r) ==
    /\ target[r] # None
    /\ seen[r] # ver[target[r]]
    /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![r] = ver[target[r]]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, busy, ver, target>>
SetBusy(c) ==
    /\ ~busy[c]
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, ver, target, seen>>
ClearBusy(c) ==
    /\ busy[c]
    /\ busy' = [busy EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, ver, target, seen>>
Collect(c) ==
    /\ load[c] > 0
    /\ ver[c] < MaxVer
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<busy, target, seen>>
Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Routers, c \in Carousels : Observe(r, c)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Place(r) \/ Retry(r)
    \/ \E c \in Carousels : SetBusy(c) \/ ClearBusy(c) \/ Collect(c)
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
CarouselWithinCapacity == \A c \in Carousels : load[c] <= MaxCap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Routers = {r1, r2}
  Carousels = {c1, c2}
  MaxCap = 2
  MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CarouselWithinCapacity
nl:
An airport baggage system has routers that place bags onto carousels, each carousel holding a bounded number of bags. To place a bag, a router first observes a carousel's version number, then optimistically commits the placement only if the version is still unchanged and the carousel has spare capacity; a successful placement bumps the version. If a router finds the version has moved, it must re-observe and retry rather than force the placement. A carousel may go temporarily busy and refuse placements, but it is only slow, never failed: it always eventually clears its busy flag and accepts work again. Bags also leave carousels as passengers collect them, freeing capacity and bumping the version. The bounded capacity of every carousel is preserved throughout.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of bags on any carousel never exceeds its fixed capacity.

    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ carEpoch = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ moving = [c \in Cars |-> FALSE]
Sync(c) ==

    /\ carEpoch' = [carEpoch EXCEPT ![c] = epoch]

Board(c) ==
    /\ carEpoch[c] = epoch
    /\ ~moving[c]
    /\ load[c] < cap
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, epoch, carEpoch, moving>>
Exit(c) ==
    /\ load[c] > 0
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cap, epoch, carEpoch, moving>>
StartMove(c) ==
    /\ ~moving[c]
    /\ moving' = [moving EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, cap, epoch, carEpoch>>
StopMove(c) ==
    /\ moving[c]
    /\ moving' = [moving EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, cap, epoch, carEpoch>>
Reconfigure(nc) ==
    /\ nc \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ \A c \in Cars : load[c] <= nc
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ cap' = nc
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<load, carEpoch, moving>>
Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Sync(c) \/ Board(c) \/ Exit(c) \/ StartMove(c) \/ StopMove(c)
    \/ \E nc \in 1..MaxCap : Reconfigure(nc)

CONSTANTS
  Cars = {ca, cb}
  MaxCap = 3
  MaxEpoch = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LoadWithinCapacity
nl:
A bank of elevator cars serves a skyscraper under a shared capacity configuration tagged with an epoch number. Building control can reconfigure the maximum car occupancy, which bumps the epoch; a car only boards passengers once it has synced to the current epoch. A car boards a passenger only when it is synced, not mid-transit, and still below the configured capacity. Passengers also exit, freeing space. A car may start moving between floors and is then temporarily unable to board, but it is only slow, never failed: it always eventually stops and can board again. A reconfiguration may lower the capacity, but never below the occupancy any car already carries.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No elevator car ever carries more passengers than the currently configured capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od11m2p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Workers, MaxVer
VARIABLES version, value, coordBusy, phase, base
vars == <<version, value, coordBusy, phase, base>>
Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ value = 0
    /\ coordBusy = FALSE
    /\ phase = [w \in Workers |-> "idle"]
    /\ base = [w \in Workers |-> 0]
Prepare(w) ==
    /\ phase[w] = "idle"
    /\ ~coordBusy
    /\ coordBusy' = TRUE
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![w] = "prepared"]
    /\ base' = [base EXCEPT ![w] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, value>>
Commit(w) ==
    /\ phase[w] = "prepared"
    /\ base[w] = version
    /\ version < MaxVer
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ value' = value + 1
    /\ coordBusy' = FALSE
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED base
Abort(w) ==
    /\ phase[w] = "prepared"
    /\ coordBusy' = FALSE
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, value, base>>
AdminReleaseStuck ==
    /\ coordBusy
    /\ \A w \in Workers : phase[w] # "prepared"
    /\ coordBusy' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, value, phase, base>>
Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Prepare(w) \/ Commit(w) \/ Abort(w)
    \/ AdminReleaseStuck
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
NoLostUpdate == \A w \in Workers : phase[w] = "prepared" => base[w] = version
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Workers = {w1, w2, w3}
  MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A print shop maintains one shared job-accounting record that many spooler workers update through a two-phase commit protocol. A worker may only prepare a transaction when the shop coordinator is free; preparing acquires the coordinator and records the record version the worker read. The worker then commits, applying its page-count delta and bumping the record version, but only if the version it read is still current; otherwise its transaction is stale. A prepared worker may instead abort, releasing the coordinator with no change. If the coordinator ever gets stuck with no transaction prepared, an admin override can force-release it to recover. Because the coordinator serializes preparers, a committing worker always writes against the exact version it read, so no committed update is ever silently lost.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any worker that is prepared to commit has read the current record version, so its pending update cannot overwrite an intervening committed change.

---- MODULE W4Od13m8p0t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Machines
VARIABLES coarse, phase, active, crashed
Free == "free"
None == "none"
vars == <<coarse, phase, active, crashed>>
Init ==
    /\ coarse = Free
    /\ phase = [m \in Machines |-> "idle"]
    /\ active = None
    /\ crashed = [m \in Machines |-> FALSE]
AcquireCoarse(m) ==
    /\ ~crashed[m]
    /\ coarse = Free
    /\ phase[m] = "idle"
    /\ coarse' = m
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = "coarse"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<active, crashed>>
StartDispense(m) ==
    /\ ~crashed[m]
    /\ phase[m] = "coarse"
    /\ active = None
    /\ active' = m
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = "dispensing"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, crashed>>
StopDispense(m) ==
    /\ phase[m] = "dispensing"
    /\ active' = None
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = "coarse"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, crashed>>
ReleaseCoarse(m) ==
    /\ phase[m] = "coarse"
    /\ coarse = m
    /\ coarse' = Free
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<active, crashed>>
Crash(m) ==
    /\ ~crashed[m]
    /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![m] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, phase, active>>
Watchdog(m) ==
    /\ crashed[m]
    /\ coarse' = IF coarse = m THEN Free ELSE coarse
    /\ active' = IF active = m THEN None ELSE active
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![m] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed
Next == \E m \in Machines :
    AcquireCoarse(m) \/ StartDispense(m) \/ StopDispense(m) \/ ReleaseCoarse(m) \/ Crash(m) \/ Watchdog(m)
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
DispenserHoldsCoarse == active # None => coarse = active
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Machines = {m1, m2, m3}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DispenserHoldsCoarse
nl:
A network of vending machines shares one coin-validation unit that only one machine may drive at a time. To dispense, a machine first acquires the coarse network lock, then acquires the fine dispense right on the shared validator; it can never take the fine right without holding the coarse lock. A dispensing machine finishes and drops back to just holding the coarse lock, then releases the coarse lock. A machine can crash silently at any moment, simply ceasing to act while still holding whatever locks it had. A network watchdog detects a crashed machine and reclaims its coarse lock and any dispense right it held, returning the shared validator to service. The design guarantees the shared validator is driven by at most one machine at any instant.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a machine is dispensing on the shared validator, that same machine holds the coarse network lock, so no two machines drive the validator at once.

---- MODULE W4Od14m2p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Instances, Drones, MaxRec
VARIABLES owner, pstate, decided, record
None == "none"
vars == <<owner, pstate, decided, record>>
AllIdle == \A d \in Drones : pstate[d] = "idle"
Init ==
    /\ owner = None
    /\ pstate = [d \in Drones |-> "idle"]
    /\ decided = "none"
    /\ record = 0
Begin(i) ==
    /\ owner = None
    /\ AllIdle
    /\ owner' = i
    /\ decided' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pstate, record>>
Vote(d) ==
    /\ owner # None
    /\ decided = "none"
    /\ pstate[d] = "idle"
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![d] = "yes"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, decided, record>>
DecideCommit(i) ==
    /\ owner = i
    /\ decided = "none"
    /\ \A d \in Drones : pstate[d] = "yes"
    /\ decided' = "commit"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, pstate, record>>
DecideAbort(i) ==
    /\ owner = i
    /\ decided = "none"
    /\ decided' = "abort"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, pstate, record>>
ApplyCommit(d) ==
    /\ decided = "commit"
    /\ pstate[d] = "yes"
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![d] = "committed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, decided, record>>
ApplyAbort(d) ==
    /\ decided = "abort"
    /\ pstate[d] \in {"idle", "yes"}
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![d] = "aborted"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, decided, record>>
Finish(i) ==
    /\ owner = i
    /\ decided # "none"
    /\ \A d \in Drones : pstate[d] \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ record' = IF decided = "commit" /\ record < MaxRec THEN record + 1 ELSE record
    /\ pstate' = [d \in Drones |-> "idle"]
    /\ owner' = None
    /\ decided' = "none"
Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Begin(i) \/ DecideCommit(i) \/ DecideAbort(i) \/ Finish(i)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Vote(d) \/ ApplyCommit(d) \/ ApplyAbort(d)
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
AtomicOutcome == \A a, b \in Drones : ~(pstate[a] = "committed" /\ pstate[b] = "aborted")
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Instances = {i1, i2}
  Drones = {p1, p2}
  MaxRec = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AtomicOutcome
nl:
Two independent mission-control instances share a single pool of surveillance drones and coordinate target assignments through two-phase commit. Only one instance may own the shared pool at a time; the owner begins a transaction, the drones vote yes, and the owner then decides to commit or abort. On a commit decision every voting drone applies the new assignment; on an abort decision the drones roll back. A transaction finishes only when all drones have uniformly committed or uniformly aborted, after which the pool is released and the shared assignment record advances. Because a decision is global, a transaction can never leave one drone having applied the assignment while another rolled it back. This all-or-nothing discipline keeps the shared record consistent across both instances.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No two drones ever end a transaction in disagreeing states, one having committed the assignment while another aborted it.

CONSTANTS N, MaxRound, MaxLobby

None == N
vars == <<holder, round, seen, admitting, lobby, slow>>

    /\ holder = 0
    /\ round = 0
    /\ seen = [s \in Servers |-> 0]
    /\ admitting = None
    /\ lobby = 0
    /\ slow = [s \in Servers |-> FALSE]
PassToken(n) ==
    /\ holder = n
    /\ ~slow[n]
    /\ admitting = None
    /\ round < MaxRound
    /\ holder' = Succ(n)
    /\ round' = round + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seen, admitting, lobby, slow>>
Observe(n) ==
    /\ seen[n] # round
    /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![n] = round]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, round, admitting, lobby, slow>>
Admit(n) ==
    /\ holder = n
    /\ seen[n] = round
    /\ admitting = None
    /\ lobby < MaxLobby
    /\ admitting' = n
    /\ lobby' = lobby + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, round, seen, slow>>
Finish(n) ==
    /\ admitting \in Servers
    /\ admitting = n
    /\ admitting' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, round, seen, lobby, slow>>
GetSlow(n) ==
    /\ ~slow[n]
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, round, seen, admitting, lobby>>
Recover(n) ==
    /\ slow[n]
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, round, seen, admitting, lobby>>

    PassToken(n) \/ Observe(n) \/ Admit(n) \/ Finish(n) \/ GetSlow(n) \/ Recover(n)

cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  N = 3
  MaxRound = 3
  MaxLobby = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyHolderAdmits
nl:
A ring of matchmaking servers admits players into game lobbies, and only the server currently holding the ring token may admit a player. The token passes to the next server in the ring, and each pass increments a round number. A server must sync to the current round before admitting; a server whose cached round lags the token's round is stale and must not admit. Only one admission may be in progress at a time. A server can become temporarily slow and refuse to pass the token, but it is never failed: it always eventually recovers and hands the token onward. The design ensures that only the authorized, up-to-date token holder ever admits a player.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any admission in progress is being performed by the current token holder whose cached round matches the token's round.

---- MODULE W4Od1m4p6t2 ----

CONSTANTS Instances, QCap, MaxEpoch
VARIABLES queue, token, tokenEpoch, epoch, busy

vars == <<queue, token, tokenEpoch, epoch, busy>>
Init ==
    /\ queue = 0

A proposal opens when no vote is in progress and the deployed count is below capacity; drones then cast approval votes, but a crashed drone casts none. Once a quorum of approvals is gathered the deployment commits, incrementing the count of actively deployed drones, provided capacity still allows. A proposal that cannot gather quorum may be aborted, and deployed drones may later retire, freeing capacity. A drone can crash silently at any time and simply stop voting. Because every commit is guarded by both quorum and a capacity check, the number of actively deployed drones never exceeds the swarm's deployment capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of actively deployed drones never exceeds the swarm's deployment capacity.

CONSTANTS Instances, HCap, QCap, MaxOut

    /\ onHold = 0

    /\ checkedOut = 0

    /\ queue' = queue + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onHold, pulling, checkedOut>>

    /\ pulling' = [pulling EXCEPT ![i] = TRUE]

    /\ UNCHANGED <<onHold, checkedOut>>

    /\ onHold < HCap
    /\ onHold' = onHold + 1
    /\ pulling' = [pulling EXCEPT ![i] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, checkedOut>>
Bounce(i) ==
    /\ pulling[i]
    /\ onHold = HCap
    /\ pulling' = [pulling EXCEPT ![i] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, onHold, checkedOut>>
Collect ==
    /\ onHold > 0
    /\ checkedOut < MaxOut
    /\ onHold' = onHold - 1
    /\ checkedOut' = checkedOut + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, pulling>>
ReturnBook ==
    /\ checkedOut > 0
    /\ checkedOut' = checkedOut - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, onHold, pulling>>

  HCap = 2
  QCap = 2
  MaxOut = 2
INIT Init

INVARIANT HoldShelfWithinCapacity
nl:
A library's hold service is run jointly by two branch instances that share one bounded hold shelf. Patron hold requests enter a bounded request queue; when the queue is full, backpressure blocks further requests. Either branch instance may pull one queued request at a time to work on. A pulled book is placed on the hold shelf if there is room under the shelf capacity; if the shelf is full the request is bounced. Patrons collect books off the hold shelf, which then count as checked out, and checked-out books are eventually returned. Because both instances check the shelf capacity before shelving, the hold shelf never holds more books than its capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of books on the hold shelf never exceeds the shelf's fixed capacity.

    /\ target = None

    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, acting, target, pending, shed>>
Request(f) ==
    /\ f \notin pending
    /\ f \notin shed
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cEpoch, acting, target, shed>>

    /\ acting = None
    /\ cEpoch[c] = epoch
    /\ f \in pending
    /\ acting' = c
    /\ target' = f
    /\ pending' = pending \ {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cEpoch, shed>>
FinishShed(c) ==
    /\ acting = c
    /\ shed' = shed \cup {target}
    /\ acting' = None
    /\ target' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cEpoch, pending>>
Restore(f) ==
    /\ f \in shed
    /\ shed' = shed \ {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cEpoch, acting, target, pending>>

    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Sync(c) \/ FinishShed(c)

  Controllers = {c1, c2}
  Feeders = {f1, f2}
  MaxEpoch = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyCurrentControllerActs
nl:
A power-grid load shedder is controlled under a configuration tagged with an epoch number, and only a controller synced to the current epoch may shed load. Operators reconfigure the grid, bumping the epoch, but only while no shed action is in progress. Shed requests for feeders accumulate in an unordered pending set, so they may be acted on in any order. A controller must sync its cached epoch to the current epoch before acting; a controller whose cached epoch is stale must not act. To shed, a synced controller picks any pending feeder and begins the action, then finishes by moving that feeder into the shed set; shed feeders can later be restored. Only one shed action runs at a time. Only a controller whose cached epoch matches the current epoch ever performs a shed.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any controller currently performing a shed action has a cached epoch equal to the current configuration epoch.

  N = 2
  Cases = {c1, c2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OperateAtMostOnce
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler passes a scheduling token around a ring of surgeons, and only the current token holder may schedule a case into an operating room. Case requests accumulate in an unordered pending set, so the holder may schedule them in any order. Scheduling moves a case from pending into the scheduled set, but only if that case has not already been operated on. The irreversible operation then moves a scheduled case into the operated set, where it remains permanently. A case that has been operated on is never scheduled again, so it can never be operated on twice. The token continues to circulate regardless. The design guarantees the irreversible operation happens at most once per case.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No case is ever simultaneously scheduled for operation and already operated on, so the irreversible operation cannot recur for any case.

EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Students, Cap, QCap, MaxLease
VARIABLES lease, enrolled, waitCount, slow
vars == <<lease, enrolled, waitCount, slow>>
Init ==
    /\ lease = [s \in Students |-> 0]
    /\ enrolled = {}
    /\ waitCount = 0
    /\ slow = FALSE
Request ==
    /\ waitCount < QCap
    /\ waitCount' = waitCount + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, enrolled, slow>>
Hold(s) ==
    /\ ~slow
    /\ lease[s] = 0
    /\ s \notin enrolled
    /\ waitCount > 0
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![s] = MaxLease]
    /\ waitCount' = waitCount - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, slow>>
Tick(s) ==
    /\ lease[s] > 1
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![s] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, waitCount, slow>>
Expire(s) ==
    /\ lease[s] = 1
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<enrolled, waitCount, slow>>
Confirm(s) ==
    /\ lease[s] > 0
    /\ Cardinality(enrolled) < Cap
    /\ enrolled' = enrolled \cup {s}
    /\ lease' = [lease EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<waitCount, slow>>
Withdraw(s) ==
    /\ s \in enrolled
    /\ enrolled' = enrolled \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, waitCount, slow>>
SetSlow ==
    /\ ~slow
    /\ slow' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, enrolled, waitCount>>
Recover ==
    /\ slow
    /\ slow' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, enrolled, waitCount>>
Next ==
    \/ Request \/ SetSlow \/ Recover
    \/ \E s \in Students : Hold(s) \/ Tick(s) \/ Expire(s) \/ Confirm(s) \/ Withdraw(s)

  Cap = 2
  QCap = 2
  MaxLease = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SeatsWithinCap
nl:
A university course-registration system holds a bounded number of confirmed seats. Registration requests accumulate in a bounded queue; when the queue is full, backpressure blocks new requests. A student takes a temporary seat lease by consuming one queued request, and the lease carries an expiry countdown. While a lease is active its timer ticks down, and if it reaches its final tick the lease expires and the temporary hold is released. Before expiry, a student may confirm the lease into a permanent enrollment, but only if the confirmed seat count is below capacity; confirming releases the lease. The registrar server can become temporarily slow and decline to grant new leases, but it is never failed and always eventually recovers. The number of confirmed enrollments never exceeds the seat capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of confirmed enrollments never exceeds the course's seat capacity.

  Robots = {r1, r2}
  MaxVer = 3
  MaxLease = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet is coordinated by two independent controller instances that share one pool of robots and one shared inventory record. A controller grants a robot an exclusive update lease on the record when the record is free, capturing the record's current version at grant time; the lease carries an expiry countdown. Only the lease holder may commit an update, and it commits only if the version it captured still matches, after which it advances the version and releases the lease. While a lease is active its timer ticks down, and if it reaches its final tick the lease expires with no update. A holder may renew its lease before expiry, re-capturing the current version. Because only the single lease holder can advance the record and it does so against the version it captured, no committed update is ever silently overwritten.
SAFETY PROPERTY: While any robot holds the update lease, the version it captured still equals the record's current version, so its commit cannot overwrite an intervening update.

    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, slow>>

    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, occ, signal>>

INVARIANT BlockWithinCapacity
nl:
A subway line is governed by signal controllers arranged in a ring, holding a single admission token. Only the controller currently holding the token may admit a train into a track block, and the token circulates to the next controller in the ring. Each block has a bounded capacity of trains and a signal that must be green to admit; admitting a train fills one slot and turns the block's signal red until a train departs. A departing train frees one slot and turns the signal green again. A controller can become temporarily slow and neither pass the token nor admit, but it is never failed and always eventually recovers. Because every admission is guarded by both the token and the block's capacity check, no block ever holds more trains than its capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of trains in any track block never exceeds that block's fixed capacity.

    /\ term = 0
    /\ up = [n \in Nodes |-> TRUE]
    /\ acting = None
    /\ actTerm = 0
Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = None
    /\ up[n]
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, acting, actTerm>>
StartDispatch(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ up[n]
    /\ acting = None
    /\ acting' = n
    /\ actTerm' = term
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, up>>
FinishDispatch(n) ==
    /\ acting = n
    /\ acting' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, up, actTerm>>
Depose(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ leader' = None
    /\ acting' = IF acting = n THEN None ELSE acting
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, up, actTerm>>
Fail(n) ==
    /\ up[n]
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ leader' = IF leader = n THEN None ELSE leader
    /\ acting' = IF acting = n THEN None ELSE acting
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, actTerm>>
Recover(n) ==
    /\ ~up[n]
    /\ up' = [up EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, acting, actTerm>>
AdminAppoint(n) ==
    /\ up[n]
    /\ acting = None
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<up, acting, actTerm>>

    Elect(n) \/ StartDispatch(n) \/ FinishDispatch(n) \/ Depose(n) \/ Fail(n) \/ Recover(n) \/ AdminAppoint(n)

CONSTANTS
  Nodes = {n1, n2, n3}
  MaxTerm = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyCurrentLeaderActs
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet is directed by one elected leader node among several dispatcher nodes, with failover if the leader fails. A node is elected leader only when there is no current leader and it is up, and election advances the term. Only the current leader may run a dispatch, and when it begins a dispatch it records the term it started under. A leader may be deposed or may fail, which vacates the leadership and cancels any dispatch it had in progress; failed nodes may later recover. A warehouse admin holds an override that can appoint any up node as leader immediately, advancing the term, but only while no dispatch is in progress. Because a dispatch is bound to its leader and term, any dispatch in progress is being driven by the current leader under the current term.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any dispatch in progress is being run by the node that is currently leader, under a recorded term equal to the current term.
